3698-5267-7924.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
When the Clue enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat.

4574-6798-6900-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
4574-6798-6900-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

1829-4279-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1829-4279-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4770-4927-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-1808-6625-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

6495-6528-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6528-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2511-5035-5104.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
2511-5035-5104.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

1409-3099-4068-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1409-3099-4068-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-1355-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-7297.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7768.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Chaotic Goo enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

2724-6432-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
2724-6432-7334.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Neutrinos. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-3185-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Evernight Shade enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2438-3185-6972.notes: If Evernight Shade starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

2440-3480-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4659-5346-6441-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of it due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Improvised Arsenal tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2730-5237-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

773-1409-1770.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve both Galazeth Prismari triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2438-6517-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3767-3918-4306-7040.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
3767-3918-4306-7040.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color you have devotion to
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-4050-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4050-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

515-1636-3181.description:
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping the land with Squirrel Nest attached.
Repeat.
515-1636-3181.notes: If you have seven or more cards in your graveyard, you can untap up to three lands using Krosan Restorer instead.

372-2072-2974.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Scrollshift.
372-2072-2974.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Scrollshift.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

116-4753-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Clever Impersonator on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Clever Impersonator do not have summoning sickness.
116-4753-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Clever Impersonator.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Clever Impersonator.
Activate Clever Impersonator by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2281-5256-6125.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Fiendish Panda's power.
Repeat.

222-4871-5147-5221.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Sporuting Thrinax and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Sprouting Thrinax die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Sprouting Thrinax triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 1 and 5.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2084-3203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2084-3203.description:
Cast Polymorphous Rush by paying {2}{U}, causing another creature you control to become a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm until end of turn.
Activate the creature by paying {1}{U}, shuffling it into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

567-1981-3129-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 50.
567-1981-3129-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating 100 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers 100 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

1308-1651-4259-4659.description:
Activate Collector's Vault by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to loot and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Collector's Vault.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2104-2660-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you have an empty library.
Resolve the first Phyrexian Devourer ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it.
If Phyrexian Devourer's power is at least seven, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from your library.
Repeat from step 6.

232-732-1636-4395.notablePrerequisites: Lightning Prowess attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
232-732-1636-4395.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

1012-3179-3676-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}.
Oketra's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior token.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
